Console players quarter up! 2XKO launches on PS5 and Series X! 

The Free to play 2v2 Tag Fighter from Riot Games is unleashing its first season, featuring a brand new champion in the form of Caitlyn. Caitlyn is an expert zoner, firing off shots from a distance and laying traps to ensare careless opponents. Season 1 will also see new skins, battlepass, and more added! 

2XKO Season 1 is available January 20th for PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

Check out this latest trailer for Marathon, the extraction-shooter from Bungie! 

Scavenge for loot in a lost colony in this new PvPvE extraction shooter from the creators of Halo and Destiny. Battle against other players and AI opponents as a team or as a lone wolf, as you attempt to escape the hostile world of Tau Ceti IV with everything you can carry! 

Marathon launches March 5th, 2026 for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

title: Marathon - Official Pre-Order Trailer

author: IGN
description:
It’s been nearly three years since Cult of the Lamb first launched, and Massive Monster hasn’t stopped expanding its twisted little world. With the Woolhaven paid expansion launching January 22, introducing a new winter-themed region and major systems like animal ranching, now is the perfect time to look back at everything that’s led up to it. Since release, the action roguelike and base-management hybrid has received four major free updates, adding new story content, resources, buildings, combat systems, game modes, and even co-op.

Whether you’re returning to your cult or jumping in for the first time, there’s never been a better moment to get indoctrinated. Before Woolhaven arrives, we’re breaking down everything major that’s been added to Cult of the Lamb so far, from post-game storylines and new weapons to accessibility options and permadeath modes.

#IGN
title: Cult of the Lamb:  Everything Major Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Cinematic Launch Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, a free-to-play anime action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Players will take the fight to the Ankhor and Blight by way of leading the expansion of Endfield Industries across a planet from region to region. 

Harness the abilities of a suite of Operators with kits to fit a plethora of different playstyles. Arknights: Endfield is launching on January 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official Cinematic Launch Trailer
